children: The Canadian dollar weakened against the greenback on Thursday, and the yield on benchmark government debt slipped.
was trading 0.2% lower at C$1.412 to the greenback, or 70.82 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.409 to 1.4124.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) fell 0.8 basis points to 3.946%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt fell to 5.1039%.
futures rose $1.78 to $93.94 a barrel on Thursday.

Canadian retail sales fell 0.7% in August from July. Analysts polled by Reuters had expected retail sales to drop 0.8%.Excluding autos, retail sales fell 0.7% in August, Statistics Canada said.  Analysts had forecast August sales, excluding autos, to be down 0.5%.
